Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect to trash a digivolution card from another of my Digimon?

Effect: [When Moving] [On Play] By trashing 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
Inherited Effect: When effects trash this card from a [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
